name: The Caretaker's Letter
description: Your caretaker's last letter sends you to Zarithax the Golden, the Scalekeeper of the Ember Vault in Goldenhaven, who has held your inheritance in trust. Claim it, then get yourself ready for the road.

start_condition.start_hint: Every new character who starts in Goldenhaven begins with this, from their caretaker's letter.

hub.text: Zarithax regards you from behind the Ember Vault's counter, eyes glinting like coals. "You have business with the Ember Vault?"

inherit.label: My caretaker left something here for me.
inherit.text: Zarithax reads the letter without expression, then sets it down precisely. "An account held in trust these eighteen years, under your sigil. There is a keeping fee, as there always is." A pause, and something like warmth. "Your caretaker never once missed a payment. For one of our own blood, the fee is waived. The Merchant Princes won the peace, after all; we can afford to be generous to our own." "Your caretaker's savings are in the vault, and a Homeward Stone, attuned to our waystone the year you were born. They paid full price for the attuning. I remember the bargaining."

ask-sigil.label: How did you know it was me?
ask-sigil.text: "Every soul is born with a true sigil. It cannot be forged, which is the only reason the Ember Vault does business with anyone at all. Gold changes hands. A sigil does not."

ask-caretaker.label: Did you know my caretaker?
ask-caretaker.text: "They bargained for every copper of the fee, every year, and lost every year with good grace." Zarithax's tail flicks. "I came to look forward to it. That is not something I say of many people."

ask-stone.label: What is a Homeward Stone?
ask-stone.text: "A Homeward Stone returns you to the waystone in Golden Square, from anywhere in the realm. It needs a week to recover after each use. Your caretaker paid for it so you would always have a way back to your own people."

take.label: I'd like to see it.
take.text: Zarithax opens the Ember Vault with a word and a flare of heat. "Choose. I will note what you take."

skip.label: I've done this before. Just the gear, please.
skip.text: "Decisive. A good trait in this city." The vault opens.

vault.label: Could you open my vault?
vault.text: A word, and the Ember Vault opens with a breath of heat. "Take what is yours. What you leave is safe, and any keeper who has accepted you can open this same vault in any city."

supplies.label: Where can I buy supplies for the road?
supplies.text: "Aurelia Goldscale's trading house, by the Western Gate. Buy something for the road. Everyone in Goldenhaven will try to sell you something; it is a good habit to buy from someone reputable."

lessons.label: Is there anything else I should do first?
lessons.text: "If you were taught magic, prepare it before you need it: open your Spells & Abilities and set a spell in a slot. Unprepared magic is an unpaid debt."

bed.label: Where should I sleep tonight?
bed.text: "The Caravan Rest Inn, at the Western Gate. Crusher keeps it, and the breakfast is better than his name suggests. Sleep, then save your game. In Goldenhaven, what isn't written down didn't happen. Then return to me."

completed.option: Thank you for keeping it safe.

after.text: "You've rested and you've written it down. Good." Zarithax inclines their head. "The vault keepers post the realm's bounties, daily and weekly. Come to me for work. And the waystone in the square: it has dimmed. Oracle Seraphina at the temple has opinions about why. Most of them are unsettling."

trade-merchant.option: I'm new in town. What do I need for the road?

advice.text: "You will want rations." Aurelia's golden eyes weigh your purse. "A meal's worth each, sealed against rot. When you feel Hungry, eat one: right-click it in your pack, then Eat. Light, rope and a whetstone, if your coin stretches. Quality costs, and it lasts."

how-buy.label: How do I buy something?
how-buy.text: "Look over the stock, then right-click what you want: Buy 1, or Buy X. Click an item for its price. A silver tongue earns a better one. To sell, use the Sell tab and lay your goods on the counter."

room.text: "One night per room." Crusher's voice rumbles like a cart on cobbles. "Pay, take your key, go up. Beds are for after nine. Breakfast is included. The caravans leave early, so check-out is at ten."

stages.description: Your caretaker left you a letter. Read it: right-click it in your bag and choose Read.
stages.tip: Items have actions: right-click one (long-press on a phone) to see what you can do with it. Your next step always shows in the quest tracker over the scene, and the Quest Log has the rest.

stages.description: The letter sends you to Zarithax the Golden, the Scalekeeper, at the Ember Vault in Golden Square. Go inside and talk to them.
stages.tip: Buildings are listed under Buildings: click one to go in. Inside, the People column shows who's there; click someone to talk. Time stands still while you talk.

objectives.description: Talk to Zarithax the Golden at the Ember Vault.

stages.description: Zarithax has held your inheritance in trust. Ask for it, and choose what suits you.
stages.tip: Ask the keeper for it, then choose one option on each screen. Tap ? on any item to see what it does: damage, armor, weight, value. Once it's yours, what you can wear you'll be wearing: check the Equipment tab, and what you carry in Inventory.

objectives.description: Take up your inheritance from Zarithax.

stages.description: Your caretaker's savings and your Homeward Stone are in your vault. Ask Zarithax to open it, and take both out.
stages.tip: Your vault is one store shared across the realm: deposit here, withdraw in any city whose keeper has accepted you. What's in it is safe, even if you fall. In the vault window, click an item to take it (set the amount first: 1, 5, 10 or ALL), or drag it into your bag. Gold has weight, so carry what you'll spend and leave the rest here. Your Homeward Stone: right-click → Use to return to your city's waystone, then it rests for a week.

objectives.description: Take your gold from the vault.
Take your Homeward Stone from the vault.

stages.description: Buy something for the road. Aurelia Goldscale keeps the Goldscale Trading House in the Western Gate; any shop will do.
stages.tip: Shops: talk to the shopkeeper and browse. To buy, right-click an item → Buy 1 or Buy X (click it to see the price; your Charisma helps). To sell, open the Sell tab, click your items to put them on the counter, then confirm the sale. Rations are food that never spoils: when you're Hungry, right-click one → Eat. Your bag: the 4 general slots are your belt, the things you can reach in a fight; the darker slots are your backpack. Drag items onto a container (backpack, pouch) to put them in, or right-click it → Open. Bag full? Use your backpack, or leave things in the vault.

objectives.description: Buy supplies at the Goldscale Trading House.

stages.description: If you learned magic, have it ready before you need it. Open Spells & Abilities and prepare a spell in a slot.
stages.tip: Spells & Abilities: your spell slots are at the top, the spells you know below. Click an empty slot to choose a spell for it. Cantrips are ready at once; a levelled spell takes an hour per level to prepare, and the clock has to run. Spells cost mana, and some need runes or components. In a fight you cast from the combat bar. Outside one, right-click a prepared spell → Cast: that works for spells that heal, cure, create something or leave a lasting effect.

stages.description: Take a room at the Caravan Rest Inn in the Western Gate and sleep. Inns serve breakfast, so you'll wake well fed. Then save your game: there's no autosave, so a save is how you keep what you've done.
stages.tip: Inns: talk to the innkeeper to rent a room (one night, breakfast included, check-out at 10 AM), go into your room (Rooms), then Sleep, any time after 9 PM. Sleep is what clears fatigue; 🕐 Wait only passes the time. Saving: Settings → Save game, or Ctrl+S. There's no autosave, so closing the game takes you back to your last save.

objectives.description: Sleep at the Caravan Rest Inn.

stages.description: Go back to Zarithax at the Ember Vault and tell them you're settled.
stages.tip: Vault keepers post the realm's bounties, a new one every day and every week: ask any keeper for work.
